purpose: Validate one evidence-backed real-use visual fallback candidate through the normal agent loop without shipping a built-in contract. The caller materializes a scoped exact contract for the current temporary Pulsar document. Semantic OPEN must fail with NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET before local Vision selection; the exact UTF-8 status target is clicked only after an exact caller-derived window-title surface precondition; CLICK_POSTED is delivery only; verified success requires an independent post-action local Vision observation of UTF-16 LE in Pulsar's encoding selector.

postconditionBasis.claim: The encoding selector populates modal items from the declared encoding list; UTF-16 LE is a declared list label. This fixes the exact postcondition before physical delivery rather than deriving success from the observed result.

safety: Pulsar must not already be running; otherwise the session is BLOCKED
the document is created in a temporary directory and its SHA-256 content hash must remain unchanged
the encoding selector is opened but no encoding selection is confirmed
caller scope, surface identity, postcondition and provider request remain outside the planner
semantic-first eligibility must be structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET before provider selection
only local rumiai.local.macos-vision-text-region perception is allowed
CLICK_POSTED is delivery evidence only and has semanticConsequenceVerified=false
VERIFIED_SUCCESS requires exact UTF-16 LE from an independent post-action Vision observation
no raw semantic snapshot, screenshot, OCR payload or coordinates are persisted
the test initiates no external network request
Escape dismisses the selector, the original pointer position is restored, Pulsar and Computer Control are terminated, and temporary files are removed
no built-in contract or skill is promoted by this session

lineage.p7aFinding: JavaScript and UTF-8 are structured semantic CLICK gaps and local Vision exact targets on a real temporary Pulsar JavaScript document.
lineage.p7bFinding: The Pulsar current-window title is exact, discriminating, and reconstructible from caller-owned filename and parent path information.

onPass.next: Design P7D promotion boundaries: decide where caller-owned document context materializes the scoped dynamic contract, add the smallest competence/skill integration needed for the UTF-8 encoding-selector action, preserve semantic-only planning and dynamic exact surface identity, then contract-test before any shipped registry knowledge. Do not promote generic Pulsar status-bar clicking.
